scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); let d={}; try{d=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('version.json','utf8'))}catch(e){} fs.writeFileSync('version.json', JSON.stringify({version:d.version||'1.0.149',buildTime:Date.now()},null,2)); console.log('[Build] Auto-generated fresh buildTime:', Date.now())"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx netlify deploy --prod
